$comment: MF-42 (FE-31; plan.min cut 5, P42-D9 a): the one data home of the binding boundary. libraries = the MaxBLD-new UI packages (one tier); they may be imported only by a listed binding module, a listed provider, a test file or the vendor dir. Shape: screen-data.schema.json#/definitions/bindings. Read by scripts/surfaces/screen-checks.mjs and the FE-31 and FE-05 locks.
